record.title: Zimbabwe COVID general passenger closure
record.crossings: Beitbridge; Plumtree; Victoria Falls; Chirundu; Nyamapanda; Forbes
record.direction: Zimbabwe-imposed land admission restrictions; December1 passage observed in both directions at Beitbridge. Exact outward exceptions throughout not exhaustively established.
record.movement: Non-exempt ordinary land passengers; December1 relaxation for private-vehicle travellers and pedestrians at announced major-post subset
record.exceptions: Returning residents and cargo; September contemporary reporting also identifies diplomats. Full authorised-exception history not exhaustively recovered.
record.enforcement: December1 actual passage reported at Beitbridge and Plumtree, with observations at Victoria Falls; policy reopening at all six announced posts is not six independent gate observations. March23 immediate-effect announcement is formal-policy evidence, not freshly observed gate enforcement.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; current status not inferred
record.context: Presidential announcement took immediate effect; six main ports later reopened for pedestrians and private vehicles.
record.uncertainty: 253 days is a scoped formal-policy interval for non-exempt ordinary land admission at Beitbridge through observed December1 relaxation. March23 operational implementation was not independently observed in sources inspected; direction-specific and other authorised exceptions remain incompletely catalogued. Six-post announcement is not universal implementation proof. Public transport and other categories require separate phase tracking.

historical.duration_note: 253 calendar-date days from immediate-effect formal policy onset March23 to observed December1 ordinary-passenger relaxation at Beitbridge, restricted to non-exempt land admissions. Not a universal physical closure or measured hours; not six independently observed continuous gate histories.
